trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long Gold. After the story, a 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats, and this trophy is for finishing all of it — though guide sites stress it is closer to 60% of everything the game tracks: progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. The demanding parts are the categories that must be done in full — every robbery, all 33 underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races and Bret's quests — plus 70 of the 80 Challenges, 300 stunts, scanning 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles and studying 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy of the list and the reason the Platinum runs to about 200 hours.

Clear the must-complete categories: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's quests
Reach 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 stunts, 200 vehicle scans and 100 animals studied

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The vague description hides a fitness goal: reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia. The efficient method is to train them together — visit fitness clubs as a pair so the partner you are not controlling trains alongside the one you are, and both Strength stats climb together instead of one at a time.
steps: Visit fitness clubs with both characters together
Train until Jason's Strength is at maximum
Train until Lucia's Strength is at maximum

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A long-counter trophy for your Criminal Profile: it takes 500 profile-affecting actions — the choices and crimes the game logs against your profile — so the practical advice is simply to leave it late. Robberies and enemy encounters feed it naturally across a platinum run, and it may well complete itself; check it during final cleanup before grinding anything. One warning from guide sites: avoid ending up with the Irredeemable criminal profile, which is permanent and makes police more aggressive.
steps: Play normally — robberies and fights add profile actions
Check the counter during final cleanup
Top up with robberies and encounters if it is still short
Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: One of the hidden trophies guide sites had not solved during launch week, so no honest step-by-step exists yet. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — points at succeeding on a second attempt at something that failed the first time. Keep your chapter saves, play naturally, and if you fail a notable one-off event, try it again rather than reloading: a retry may be exactly what this is counting.
steps: Play naturally and keep chapter saves
When a one-off attempt fails, retry it instead of reloading
Check back with guide sites as the trigger gets confirmed

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A secret trophy whose trigger was still unconfirmed in launch week — the name and its 'What the hell just happened?' description point at witnessing one of the game's strange, unexplained events rather than a repeatable task. There is no confirmed method to cite, so the honest advice is to explore Leonida thoroughly (which The Goodtime State asks of you anyway) and investigate odd sights and encounters instead of driving past them.

Investigate strange events and encounters when you find them
Check guide sites for a confirmed trigger as the community solves it

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description is the instruction: bowl people over with a melee drive-by — drive past a group on foot and strike them with a melee attack from the vehicle, knocking several down like pins in one pass. A crowded pavement is the setup; ride or drive along it and swing as you pass. Guide sites had not published a confirmed count during launch week, so if one pass does not pop it, line up a denser group and repeat.
steps: Find a crowded pavement
Approach on a bike or in a car at moderate speed
Use a melee drive-by to knock down several people in one pass

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robbery scores; instead of spending them raw, route them through your laundering contacts until the laundered total reaches a quarter of a million. This is a money grind that pairs naturally with the robbery trophies and the 100% checklist's robbery categories — bank vaults and gang operations are the richest sources.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies
Deliver them to your laundering contacts
Repeat until $250,000 has been laundered

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Almost everything you buy counts toward the same pot — clothes, hairstyles, tattoos, vehicle work and property spending all add up — so on a 200-hour platinum run this usually arrives by itself. If you are close at cleanup time, the fastest top-up is a shopping spree you were going to do anyway; just hold back the $160,000 the eight garages for Little Boxes cost until those are bought.
steps: Spend normally on clothes, services and vehicles
Watch the total climb toward $100,000
Top up with a deliberate spree if it is still short late in the run

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — but only the eight buyable garages count; the four garages the story gives you do not need buying and do not count. Garage buying opens through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, and the full set costs about $160,000 in total, so budget for it before splurging elsewhere. The extra parking also helps On the Spot, which needs room for registered vehicles.
steps: Unlock the Vice City Real Estate app (after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver)
Buy each of the eight purchasable garages (~$160,000 in total)
Ignore the four story garages — they do not count

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app unlocks through the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take eligible stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down, and early on Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers — from Chapter 3, Standard Tracker vehicles and registration at Pay 'n' Spray locations open up. You also need garage space for what you register, which is where Little Boxes helps.
steps: Unlock Scooter Bros in the Chapter 2 mission Moses
Bring an eligible stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn
Choose Respray, then Register
Repeat with cheap cars and bikes until 10 are registered
